scope.method: Targeted full-original methods/results/asset inspection when lawfully available. Every candidate has documented real retrieval/search attempts. HTTP errors and download pages are not equated with a universal absence of lawful full text. Primary means verified original adult conventional-lispro PK contribution; U100 verification is a separate nullable field, and mixed/unidentified strata remain unresolved. Full-text access does not imply that every supplemental asset was inspected, clinical validity, or exact curve reproducibility. No author contact, purchase, or restricted-data acquisition occurred.

records.title: Ultra rapid lispro lowers postprandial glucose and more closely matches normal physiological glucose response compared to other rapid insulin analogues: A phase 1 randomized, crossover study.

records.overlap_and_ancestry: Four-treatment crossover; healthy subjects are separate. Different trial identifier from NCT03166124; personal overlap is not independently audited. Five implausible aspart-treatment observations excluded, not a reason to discard all lispro data.

remaining_gaps: Exact doses/covariates and individual observations unavailable; concentration unresolved; linked DOCX supplement not inspected.
